func testPorkLedRibsAppearUnderPorkAtNormalText() {
        continueAfterFailure = false
        XCUIDevice.shared.orientation = .portrait
        let app = XCUIApplication()
        app.launchArguments = ["-UITesting", "-qaLibraryPorkGrouping", "-UIPreferredContentSizeCategoryName", "UICTContentSizeCategoryL"]
        app.launch()
        let pork = app.descendants(matching: .any)["section.Pork"].firstMatch
        let chicken = app.descendants(matching: .any)["section.Chicken"].firstMatch
        let ribs = app.staticTexts["Sticky Ribs and wings"]
        let wings = app.staticTexts["Lemon pepper wings"]
        XCTAssertTrue(chicken.waitForExistence(timeout: 10))
        XCTAssertTrue(pork.waitForExistence(timeout: 5))
        XCTAssertTrue(ribs.exists); XCTAssertTrue(wings.exists)
        XCTAssertLessThan(chicken.frame.maxY, wings.frame.minY)
        XCTAssertLessThan(wings.frame.maxY, pork.frame.minY)
        XCTAssertLessThan(pork.frame.maxY, ribs.frame.minY,
                          "The pork-led ribs recipe belongs below Pork, not in Chicken")
        XCTAssertTrue(pork.isHittable); XCTAssertTrue(ribs.isHittable)
        let capture = XCTAttachment(screenshot: XCUIScreen.main.screenshot())
        capture.name = "library-pork-led-ribs-normal-main-ingredient-groups"
        capture.lifetime = .keepAlways
        add(capture)
    }

func testBottomBarsDoNotOverlapRecipeDetail() {
        captureCoverageLaunch = true
        defer { captureCoverageLaunch = false }
        launch(["-simulateOffline"])
        coverageLaunchMark("body-after-launch")
        addPrompt("miso salmon")
        app.buttons["Cook mode"].tap()
        wait(text("Step 1 of"))
        app.buttons["Next step"].tap(); app.buttons["Next step"].tap()
        app.buttons["Start timer"].tap()
        wait(app.buttons["Pause timer"], 5)
        app.buttons["Exit"].tap()
        let cook = app.buttons["Cook mode"]; wait(cook)
        let bar = app.buttons["timerBarOpen"].firstMatch
        let banner = app.descendants(matching: .any)["offlineBanner"].firstMatch
        wait(bar, 5); wait(banner, 5)
        shot("detail-bottom-bars")
        XCTAssertLessThan(banner.frame.midY, app.frame.midY, "offline banner belongs at the top")
        // C-FIX-03: the strip sits below the nav bar, never on top of it or the title.
        let nav = app.navigationBars.firstMatch
        if nav.exists { XCTAssertGreaterThanOrEqual(banner.frame.minY + 1, nav.frame.maxY, "offline banner overlaps the nav bar") }
        XCTAssertLessThanOrEqual(cook.frame.maxY, bar.frame.minY + 1, "Cook mode overlaps the timer bar")
        XCTAssertEqual(app.buttons.matching(identifier: "timerBarOpen").count, 1, "timer bar shown once")
        let ask = app.textFields["askField"]
        scrollTo(ask)
        XCTAssertTrue(ask.isHittable)
        XCTAssertFalse(ask.frame.intersects(cook.frame), "Ask Ate field under Cook mode")
        XCTAssertFalse(ask.frame.intersects(bar.frame), "Ask Ate field under the timer bar")
    }

func testCookModeCompletionRecordsCookingDay() {
        captureAddTitleQuery = true
        defer { captureAddTitleQuery = false }
        launch(["-qaAccountJourneyAnimationDiagnostic", "-qaAddTitleQueryDiagnostic"])
        addPromptRecipe()
        app.buttons["Cook mode"].tap()
        wait(text("Step 1 of 4"))

        let finish = app.buttons["cookFinish"]
        var steps = 0
        while !finish.exists && steps < 6 {
            let next = app.buttons["Next step"]
            wait(next, 5)
            next.tap()
            steps += 1
        }
        wait(finish, 5)
        finish.tap()
        // Finish confirms the saved cook before returning to recipe detail. Do not
        // query background buttons/tabs through the still-present completion sheet.
        wait(app.staticTexts["cookCompletion.recorded"], 5)
        let completionDone = app.buttons["cookReflection.notNow"]
        wait(completionDone, 5)
        XCTAssertEqual(app.buttons.matching(identifier: "cookReflection.notNow").count, 1)
        completionDone.tap()
        wait(app.buttons["Cook mode"], 5)

        // Completion must update the persistent Tracker, not merely dismiss Cook Mode.
        tabFromRecipeDetail("Journal", recipeTitle: "Miso salmon for two")
        // Journal is the tab root; Insights & Cooking History is its one named route.
        let hub = app.buttons["journal.insightsHistory"].firstMatch
        XCTAssertTrue(hub.waitForExistence(timeout: 10), "Journal root must expose Insights & Cooking History")
        hub.tap()
        let day = Calendar.current.component(.day, from: Date())
        let today = app.buttons["tracker.day.\(day)"]
        wait(today, 5)
        XCTAssertTrue(today.label.contains("cooked") && today.label.contains("today"),
                      "Finish cooking should mark today's Tracker date as cooked: \(today.label)")
        today.tap()
        wait(app.navigationBars["Cooked that day"], 5)
        XCTAssertFalse(app.staticTexts["Nothing recorded for this day."].exists,
                       "The completed recipe should appear in the selected day's history")
        let recordedRecipe = app.descendants(matching: .any).matching(
            NSPredicate(format: "identifier BEGINSWITH %@", "tracker.recipe.")
        ).firstMatch
        wait(recordedRecipe, 5)
    }

func test06_CookMode() {
        launch()
        addPromptRecipe()
        app.buttons["Cook mode"].tap()
        wait(text("Step 1 of 4"))
        XCTAssertFalse(app.buttons["Back"].isEnabled)
        shot("cook-step1")
        app.buttons["Next step"].tap()
        wait(text("Step 2 of 4"))
        app.buttons["Back"].tap()
        wait(text("Step 1 of 4"))
        app.buttons["Next step"].tap(); app.buttons["Next step"].tap()
        wait(text("Step 3 of 4"))
        wait(text("10:00"))
        app.buttons["Start timer"].tap()
        wait(app.buttons["Pause timer"], 5)
        sleep(2)
        XCTAssertFalse(text("10:00").exists, "timer should count down")
        shot("cook-timer-running")
        app.buttons["Pause timer"].tap()
        app.buttons["Reset timer"].tap()
        wait(text("10:00"))
        app.buttons["Next step"].tap()
        wait(text("Step 4 of 4"))
        XCTAssertFalse(app.buttons["Next step"].exists, "The final step should offer explicit completion, not a disabled Next step.")
        let finish = app.buttons["cookFinish"]
        wait(finish)
        XCTAssertEqual(finish.label, "Finish cooking")
        shot("cook-last-step")
        finish.tap()
        wait(app.buttons["Cook mode"], 5)
    }

func test06_CookMode() {
        let receipt = NamedRedReceipt(self, "cook-controls-and-completion")
        receipt.step("launch", pixels: true) { launch() }
        receipt.step("import-save-original-source") { addPromptRecipe() }
        app.buttons["Cook mode"].tap()
        wait(text("Step 1 of 4"))
        XCTAssertFalse(app.buttons["Back"].isEnabled)
        shot("cook-step1")
        app.buttons["Next step"].tap()
        wait(text("Step 2 of 4"))
        app.buttons["Back"].tap()
        wait(text("Step 1 of 4"))
        app.buttons["Next step"].tap(); app.buttons["Next step"].tap()
        wait(text("Step 3 of 4"))
        wait(text("10:00"))
        receipt.step("start-step-timer-once", pixels: true) { app.buttons["Start timer"].tap() }
        wait(app.buttons["Pause timer"], 5)
        sleep(2)
        XCTAssertFalse(text("10:00").exists, "timer should count down")
        shot("cook-timer-running")
        app.buttons["Pause timer"].tap()
        app.buttons["Reset timer"].tap()
        wait(text("10:00"))
        app.buttons["Next step"].tap()
        wait(text("Step 4 of 4"))
        XCTAssertFalse(app.buttons["Next step"].exists, "The final step should offer explicit completion, not a disabled Next step.")
        let finish = app.buttons["cookFinish"]
        wait(finish)
        XCTAssertEqual(finish.label, "Finish cooking")
        shot("cook-last-step")
        receipt.inspect("finish-button", finish)
        receipt.step("finish-once", pixels: true) { finish.tap() }
        receipt.step("assert-completion-before-exit", pixels: true) {
            wait(app.staticTexts["cookCompletion.recorded"], 5)
            let done = app.buttons["cookReflection.notNow"]
            wait(done, 5)
            XCTAssertEqual(app.buttons.matching(identifier: "cookReflection.notNow").count, 1)
            done.tap()
        }
        wait(app.buttons["Cook mode"], 5)
    }
